prompt: gives me 3 suggestions to thing to do in Paris
response: Paris, the city of love and light, offers a plethora of activities to suit every taste. You can start your day with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city. In the afternoon, explore the charming streets of Montmartre and visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica. For a unique experience, take a Seine river cruise at sunset, which offers a romantic view of the city's landmarks.
